questions.context: - `make setup` rewrites the tracked `data/dev.db`. Its `reset_fixtures.py` deletes every row in `users` (1204 rows here) and inserts 8 fixture users, and it applies migrations 0003 and 0004. The test suite needs that state: with the original `dev.db`, 17 tests fail. I restored `data/dev.db` with `git checkout`, so the diff contains only `render.py`. You'll need to run `make setup` again before testing, and it will wipe `users` in your dev database.
